intro: Tenaron's Summons marks a crucial transition for young night elves in Shadowglen. After assisting Gilshalan Windwalker with local woodland perils, you are called to ascend the massive boughs of Aldrassil to confer with Tenaron Stormgrip. This summons marks the moment a novice leaves minor local chores behind to confront the deeper spiritual afflictions touching Teldrassil.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Friend, is it? I heard that Tenaron has been asking for you. You'll find him in the highest room atop Aldrassil.
We may live long lives, but it's best you not keep him waiting too long.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah, friend. I was hoping you'd be prompt in answering my summons. I have an important task that I would like you to perform.

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
